compatibility: Compatible with unchanged funding-allocation-v0.1, E5 signed-cost/TradeResult and E6 immutable recovery semantics, provided the new registered source remains PAPER_MODEL. Public rates are observations; entry-fill notional and settlement allocation are modeled. No LIVE/private-account authority follows.

findings.problem: Bounded finite Decimal and sum(event_cost) do not yet specify precision/exponent/input-size limits, multiplication/summation context, rounding or exactness failure. Decimal operations can round under ambient context, changing financially material cost/hash across otherwise identical replay.
findings.minimal_remedy: Before implementation, fix the model-version arithmetic contract: input bounds, deterministic ordering, isolated precision derived from those bounds, rounding/quantization rule or trapped inexact rejection, and canonical signed zero. Existing ledger_funding.py:160-164 demonstrates isolated trapped-context aggregation; multiplication additionally needs coverage. Do not invent exchange rounding.

findings.problem: The required pre-entry source-health check is named but has no executable eligibility/freshness predicate. Upper-bracket completeness describes finalized allocations, not how an as-yet-open run qualifies as healthy, loses eligibility or resumes forward healthy timing; capacity/retry bounds for new funding captures remain unselected.
findings.minimal_remedy: Specify source-owned successful captured coverage/grid/settled-event evidence, actual observation time and finite validity, refresh/error/capacity state transitions and explicit new-entry/forward gating before starting observation. Keep missing future upper bracket PENDING, never zero; preserve protective/close management independently. These are engineering model rules, not new financial thresholds.

positive_boundaries: Conservative published upper bracket, fail-closed missing/changed grid, fixed exposure restriction, durable flat/pending separation, blocked next entry, immutable original clocks/lineage and versioned reports are consistent. Requirements demand real recovery/normal-path verification and new exact qualification; this review supplies none.
authority: Recommendations are technical review only, not approval of human financial/model choices. No shared E5/E6 financial reinterpretation or generic new framework is required.
